review.rationale: The retained operating-fab table uniquely identifies row 21 and pairs its 2024 value with the commercial-production commencement year header. The header and selected row each contain seven cells, including empty spacer columns at zero-based indices 1, 3 and 5; the subject and year occupy indices 0 and 2 without merged-cell inheritance. The table introduction describes the listed facilities as operating as of February 28, 2026; that later table-state cutoff is not the commencement date. The adjacent wafer-size and technology fields do not establish the technology used at commencement or additional milestone dates. Accept only the publisher-reported retrospective event for the table's source-native facility label, with inclusive year bounds and no midpoint. Do not assign a canonical entity, project phase, first-facility alias, NIST Fab 2 identity, confidence, capacity, HVM event, or earlier forecast. The reviewed location note supports Arizona at source level, but location is deliberately not admitted by this table-only rule. Filing publication and retained retrieval are separate from this review and any later actual admission. No prospective performance result or raw publisher-content redistribution follows.
